data.name: Majid
data.gender_notes: Majid is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'majd' which means glory and majesty. The name Majid carries the meaning “Glorious, Majestic” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Majid usually hope their child will grow to embody glorious, majestic and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for Allah, it is also used to describe a person who is noble and has a high status.
data.etymology: Majid belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Glorious, Majestic.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Majid total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: ماجد
in_arabic.meaning: الله کا مجید نام - مجید اللہ کی صفت ہے
in_arabic.long_meaning: ماجد اسم اللہ تعالیٰ کی صفت ہے جو مجیدیت و جمال کے معنی رکھتی ہے۔ یہ نام اللہ کی تعریف و تمجید کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ قرآن مجید میں اللہ کی صفات کے باب میں ذکر ہے۔ ماجدیت کی اصطلاح عربی زبان میں 'م-ج-د' جڑ سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'عظمت و بڑائی'۔

in_urdu.name: مجید
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ تعالیٰ کی صفت - تعریف و تمجید
in_urdu.long_meaning: مجید اللہ تعالیٰ کی صفت ہے جو تعریف و تمجید کی عظمت کو ظاہر کرتی ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں مقبول ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے کہ اللہ تعالیٰ کی بڑائی و عظمت کا اظہار کرنا۔ عربی جڑ 'م-ج-د' سے ماخوذ، جس کا مطلب ہے 'عظمت' یا 'تمجید'۔

in_hindi.name: माजिद
in_hindi.meaning: भगवान की विशेषता - प्रशंसा और महिमा
in_hindi.long_meaning: माजिद अल्लाह की विशेषता है जो प्रशंसा और महिमा की महानता को प्रकट करती है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में लोकप्रिय है और इसका अर्थ है अल्लाह की महिमा और महानता का प्रदर्शन। अरबी मूल 'म-ज-د' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है 'महिमा' या 'प्रशंसा'।

in_pashto.name: مجید
in_pashto.meaning: د الله صفت - تعریف او تمجید
in_pashto.long_meaning: مجید د الله تعالیٰ صفت ده چې تعریف او تمجید لویي څرګندوي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې مشهور دی او د الله تعالیٰ د لویي او عظمت د څرګندولو معنی لري. د عربي ريښو 'م-ج-د' څخه اخیستل شوی، چې معنی یې 'عظمت' یا 'تمجید' دی.

in_english.name: Majid
in_english.meaning: Glory of Allah - attribute of Allah
in_english.long_meaning: Majid is an attribute of Allah, expressing His glory and praise. Derived from the Arabic root 'م-ج-د' (M-J-D), meaning 'glory' or 'praise'. Mentioned in the Quran as one of Allah's attributes. Symbolizes the grandeur and magnificence of Allah. Commonly used in Muslim cultures as a given name, reflecting the importance of praising and glorifying Allah.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: مجید

data.cultural_impact: The name "Majid" carries a rich cultural significance within the Islamic community. It is often associated with royalty, dignity, and nobility. In many Middle Eastern and Islamic cultures, the name Majid is given to children as a symbol of pride and honor for their parents, reflecting the high social and moral values placed upon them. The name adds an air of sophistication and grace to individuals bearing it, and is a reminder of the grandeur and splendor of Islamic history and tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name "Majid" holds deep significance for many Muslims. It serves as a reminder of Allah's glory and majesty, and the infinite wonder and beauty of the natural world around us. It is a constant reminder to strive towards achieving excellence and nobility in our actions, and to always keep our hearts and minds focused on Allah's greatness. The name Majid is a powerful inspiration to seek knowledge, wisdom, and inner growth, and to live a life of service and devotion to Allah and His creation.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Majid was a Persian title for a ruler or governor. The name Majid carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Majid was a Persian title used for rulers and governors during the Sassanid, Seljuk, and Safavid empires.

trends: Common name in the Middle East and South Asia
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Majid is now a common name in many Middle Eastern and South Asian countries. It is often used as a given name for both boys and girls. In modern usage, the name is often transliterated as 'Majid' in the Latin script, although it is pronounced differently in various languages.
